signals.name: fake_bank_login_screen
signals.evidence: The video shows a banking login page whose address bar names a different website than the bank it imitates.

signals.name: on_screen_otp_request
signals.evidence: A caption tells the viewer to type the OTP they receive into the page.
signals.quote: Enter the OTP sent to your phone to unlock your account

signals.name: spoken_bank_officer
signals.evidence: A voice says it is a bank security officer.
signals.quote: I am calling from the bank security team

signals.name: spoken_deadline
signals.evidence: The speaker says the account will be blocked within the hour.
signals.quote: your account will be blocked within one hour
